info.name: Sprint 12 - API Gateway, CORS y flujo completo por 8080

exec: pm.test("Gateway y configuraci\u00f3n UP", () => { const health=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(health.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components.clientConfigServer.status).to.eql("UP"); pm.expect(health.components).not.to.have.property("db"); });

pm.test("Gateway y cuatro APIs UP", () => { const apps=[].concat(pm.response.json().applications.application); for (const name of ["API-GATEWAY","MS-DUENO","MS-MASCOTA","MS-VETERINARIO","MS-TURNO"]) pm.expect(apps.some(a => a.name===name && [].concat(a.instance).some(i => i.status==="UP"))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Rutas y CORS desde Git", () => { const data=pm.response.json(); const p=data.propertySources.find(s => s.name.endsWith("/api-gateway.yml")).source; pm.expect(data.version).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/); pm.expect(p["server.port"]).to.eql(8080); pm.expect(p["spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.discovery.locator.enabled"]).to.eql(true); pm.expect(p["management.endpoint.gateway.access"]).to.eql("read-only"); });

pm.test("Cuatro rutas lb y alias", () => { const routes=pm.response.json(); for (const slug of ["dueno","mascota","veterinario","turno"]) { const route=routes.find(r => r.route_id==="ms-"+slug); pm.expect(route.uri).to.eql("lb://ms-"+slug); } pm.expect(routes.some(r => r.route_id==="ms-dueno-v1")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(routes.filter(r => r.route_id.includes("DiscoveryClient")).length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(routes.length).to.eql(9); });
